name: Riells i Viabrea (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally per bend sinister into three parts, dark green triangles above and below and a broad white central band.
history: The flag was approved on 15 October 2001 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 3519 of 22 November 2001; it is an oblong flag of 2:3 divided diagonally per bend sinister into three parts, the upper and lower triangles dark green and the central diagonal, 1/3 of the imaginary diagonal wide, white.

features.role: broad band 1/3 of the diagonal from the lower hoist to the upper fly
